_note: R-PROGRESSION-BETA PB-02. A Seal is a family; its rank is the number of signed-off techniques in it, and a rank's effects are those of every signed-off technique in the family. Names and words are placeholders until PB-06; numbers are S4's, tuned in PB-09. 'live': false = Coming later (no effect, cannot be equipped).

families.name: Escape
families.text: Slip away from trouble. Blocks and Great Counters give you room.

ranks.name: Off the Line
ranks.text: A Great Counter adds two quick punches.

ranks.name: Other Side
ranks.text: A Block instantly recharges DASH, so you can get away.

ranks.name: Drive Back
ranks.text: A Great Counter pushes the attacker back.

ranks.name: Slip and Double
ranks.text: Off the Line adds a third punch, and the Great Counter window is a little longer.

families.name: Counter
families.text: Make every Great Counter count for more.

ranks.name: Spin Back Fist
ranks.text: A Great Counter also hits enemies close by.

ranks.name: Spin Elbow
ranks.text: Spin Back Fist reaches farther and hits harder.

ranks.name: Arm Wrap
ranks.text: A Great Counter traps the attacker a little longer.

ranks.name: Grab and Strike
ranks.text: Off-balance enemies take more damage, and each Great Counter restores a little Health.

ranks.name: Block and Strike
ranks.text: Blocks bounce part of the hit back at the attacker.

ranks.name: High Block Strike
ranks.text: Blocks take less damage and bounce back more, and a bounced hit leaves the attacker off-balance.

families.name: Throw
families.text: Take the attacker to the ground.

ranks.name: Outside Reap
ranks.text: A Great Counter tumbles a brute or swarmer to the ground for a moment.

ranks.name: Reap and Finish
ranks.text: Enemies you tumble take extra damage while they are on the ground.

families.name: Disarm
families.text: Take the sting out of the next attack.

ranks.name: Kick the Weapon
ranks.text: A Great Counter kicks the weapon aside, so their next hit is weaker.

ranks.name: Kick and Spin
ranks.text: Your kick lasts longer: their next two hits are weaker.

families.name: Lock
families.text: Hold the attacker still. Coming later.
